expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the append-only log milestone with TODOs; no full broker
expectations.evidence: log.go is a scaffold: types Segment/Log + signatures with TODO bodies, e.g. Append: '// TODO: 1. off := l.nextOffset ... return 0, errors.New("not implemented")'; same for NewLog/Read/Close. Only 3 milestone-1 files written (go.mod, log.go, log_test.go); no broker/TCP code — TCP is deferred ('TCP binary protocol in milestone 2'). Learner writes the core bodies.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Checkpoint test written: '// Checkpoint 1：追加 10k 条消息，读 offset 5000，内容必须正确。' with concrete expected behaviour ('Read(5000) = %q, want %q', want "msg-5000"; reopen test expects 'first offset after reopen = %d, want 500'); concrete command given/run: 'go vet ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20'; planned per-turn format includes 'how to check it (command + expected output)'.

expectations.text: B3: Describes an append-only log with offsets (segments/index)
expectations.evidence: log.go doc: 'Package minilog 实现一个 Kafka 风格的追加式日志：每条消息按到达顺序拿到单调递增的 offset，落盘为多个段（segment），每个段由一个 .log 数据文件和一个 .index 索引文件组成'; on-disk spec: '记录 = [4B payload 长度][4B crc32(payload)][payload]', '索引项 = [8B offset][8B 该记录在 .log 中的物理位置]'; segment roll: '若 active.position >= l.maxSegBytes：封口当前段...开新段'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only 2 shell commands, both clean: 'go version 2>&1; echo "---"; ls -a' and 'go vet ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -20' — no brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install. Writes limited to project files go.mod, log.go, log_test.go; other calls are reads/glob/grep of .agents/skills plus todo_write. Go 1.26.1 already present ('Environment: Go 1.26.1 on macOS arm64'), so no install needed or requested.
